title: Pointers, Arrays and Functions
goal: Array decay, pointer parameters, double pointers, dynamic 2D arrays aur callbacks ko jodna.
definition: Array expression pointer me decay hota hai; isliye functions array ko pointer ke roop me lete hain aur size alag pass karna padta hai.
explain: void f(int a[], int n) aur void f(int *a, int n) same hain. sizeof a function ke andar pointer ka size deta hai.
Pointer se function original array modify kar sakta hai; const int *a se sirf padh sakta hai.
Double pointer (int **) pointer ke array, 2D dynamic allocation aur out-parameter pointer ke liye chahiye.
Function pointer callback deta hai: qsort comparator, menu dispatch, event handlers.
analogy: Array ek ghar hai aur pointer us ghar ka address. Function ko address deते ho, isliye wo andar badlav kar sakta hai — par ghar ka size address se pata nahi chalta.
why: Strings, matrices, dynamic arrays aur callbacks sab isi integration par bane hain — interview me array-pointer equivalence ka sawaal pakka aata hai.

syntax.code:
void fill(int *a, int n) { for (int i=0;i<n;i++) a[i]=i*i; }
void print(const int *a, int n) { for (int i=0;i<n;i++) printf("%d ", a[i]); }

int (*cmp)(const void*, const void*);
qsort(a, n, sizeof a[0], cmp);

topics.title: Decay aur size
topics.body: Array parameter pointer ban jaata hai; n alag bhejo. 2D array me column width chahiye: void f(int m[][3], int rows).

topics.title: Modify through pointers
topics.body: a[i] aur *(a+i) same; pointer se likhne par caller ka array badalta hai. const correctness se galti pakdi jaati hai.

topics.title: Double pointers aur 2D heap
topics.body: int **grid = malloc(rows*sizeof *grid); har row malloc; free nested. Function me int ** se pointer ko reassign karo.

topics.title: Function pointers
topics.body: typedef int (*binop)(int,int); binop ops[] = {add, sub}; ops[choice](a,b). Callback se generic algorithms bante hain.
